name: Kurisu Rika
source:
Popular net idol and former child actor. She is currently looking for a way to return to entertainment world after getting kicked out because of not accepting its dark side.

[spoiler]She didn't really join the compensated dating scam but only went along with it because she feels lonely and needs partner to talk.[/spoiler]
